title: Track 1-only shadow mode + legacy-removable audit
claim: Track1-only shadow mode exists for current Track1 sleeves; legacy strategy jobs can be omitted; Normal-R4 provider collision with legacy is resolved structurally. NKD and route-aware safety are still pending.
claim_limits: not the full Track 1 route - NKD has no slot (5N)
not legacy-INDEPENDENT - safety sweeps still target legacy's book (5O)
legacy may be moved/deleted only after 5N + 5O + 5P
removal_mechanism: built then removed by id, from track1_slots.legacy_retirement_candidates() - the SAME table the Stage 5L classification and the retirement audit read. remove_job raises on a missing id, so a renamed job stops the build instead of surviving

swing_provider.track1_only_default: ibkr - the collision reason is structurally gone
swing_provider.transitional_default: none - legacy children still occupy every swing minute there
swing_provider.env_override: RAITS_TRACK1_SWING_PROVIDER, both directions, typo still refuses at build

legacy_removable_audit.method: meta-path import block (catches import statements AND importlib.import_module) + AST scan + state-file scan; the block is itself proven to block
legacy_removable_audit.state_mentions: Track 1's only code-level mentions of legacy state files are inside run_live_day_track1.LEGACY_PATHS - the route's own must-never-write refusal list. Naming a file to guarantee you never write it is the opposite of depending on it; asserted by test

remaining_dependency_BLOCKER.what: the 11 safety jobs (stop_repair x10 + maxhold_exit) carry --positions-path live_positions.json
remaining_dependency_BLOCKER.why_kept: any position still open in legacy's book needs its stop repaired and its five-day exit; removing the sweeps would strand it
remaining_dependency_BLOCKER.classified_as: Stage 5O blocker, named in code comment, runbook and test - not accepted as works-for-now

ops.stop_trading: not required in track1-only (nothing to halt); still required in transitional mode
ops.banner: no longer prints 'STOP_TRADING: present (legacy frozen)' - it printed a myth

defect_found_and_fixed.cause: Stage 5M-C put track1_slot_count() inside an argparse help string; operators run the file as a script, which puts monitor/ on sys.path and not the repo root
defect_found_and_fixed.why_5m_c_missed_it: its tests imported monitor.ops as a module with the root already on the path - both halves correct, the seam never crossed. Same shape as the --sleeve choices defect one stage earlier
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: track1_slot_count() puts ROOT on sys.path first; a test now runs ops.py as a subprocess the way the runbook says to

dashboard.mirror_gate: RAITS_TRACK1_ONLY=1 (implies the shadow mirror); legacy strategy rows omitted, 48 Track 1 rows + preflight + maxhold + sweeps remain

stale_text_guards: kill-switch myth regex over ops.py / run_scheduler.py / runbook, proven to catch the claim

mutations.mutation: D1 one legacy entry job survives into track1-only
D2 swing defaults to ibkr in transitional shadow
D3 track1-only loses the ibkr default
D5 track1-only demands STOP_TRADING after all
D6 a Track 1 module imports the legacy entrypoint
D7 'STOP_TRADING turns off legacy' returns to operator text
D8 the mirror ignores track1-only and mirrors legacy rows

tests.mutations: 8/8 detected, three on-disk mutations restored byte-for-byte
